t_advice_summary_textbox.text: watch for the colour of the baskets, as they correspond to different amounts. the red baskets are linked to earning a low amount eventually, and when they do, switch to another colour and aim for said new colour until the average number of mushrooms declines again.

vb_textbox.text: try to aim for 1 coloured basket at a time, theres either red or yellow. If you get yellow, for example, a few times in a row, you should switch, and try to aim for the red basket a few times in a row. keep swapping between red and yellow every time you pick them in a row. Some coloured gnomes are linked to the colour of the basket, For example- yellow, orange, blue and green gnomes lead to the yellow basket, so the remaining colours lead to red.
